featured.title: Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis
featured.tldr: WildAWM uses open models to synthesize 341 verifiable, long-horizon computer-use tasks across GUI, command line and MCP, and RL on them improves Qwen models on all eight unseen benchmarks.

featured.title: OpenGCUA: Toward a Fully Open Stack for Generalist Computer Use
featured.tldr: OpenGCUA shows that letting a model write one program per step that mixes GUI actions, shell commands and checks improves all eight tested frontier models on OSWorld-v2 while roughly halving steps per task.

featured.title: SoftwareGym: Scaling Computer-Use Agent Training with Diverse Synthesized Software Environments
featured.tldr: SoftwareGym uses coding and GUI-testing agents to synthesize 182 runnable desktop applications, and training a 9B model on trajectories from them lifts OSWorld Pass@3 from 41.39% to 56.97%.
